notes_for_editor: Thin record: no construction date, design detail or staffing found. The FFLOS register page for US 1988 is not in cache, and firetower slug guesses returned 404. The tower kind comes only from the FFLA list. The peakbagging table gives elevation 7,540 ft, which the brief lacks; the table key defines EL as elevation in feet, so it is now in facts.
